```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)

source(here("R/utils.R"))
```

## Load data

```{r load-rds}
rt_curto_rar       <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_curto_rar.rds"))
rt_g_rar           <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_g_rar.rds"))
mg_subclds_distmat <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "mg_subclds_distmat.rds"))
mg_genus_distmat   <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "mg_genus_distmat.rds"))
metadata           <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "metadata.rds"))
meta_ext           <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "meta_ext.rds"))
others             <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "others.rds"))
anova_tables_inoc  <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "anova_tables_inoc.rds"))
anova_tables_inoc_genus <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "anova_tables_inoc_genus.rds"))
```

---

## Curtobacterium subclade NMDS

```{r nmds-subclade}
set.seed(SEED)
mg_subclds_NMS <- metaMDS(mg_subclds_distmat, k = 3, maxit = 999,
                          trymax = 500, wascores = TRUE)
cat("NMDS stress:", mg_subclds_NMS$stress, "\n")
stressplot(mg_subclds_NMS)
```

```{r nmds-subclade-df}
subclades_nmds_df <- as.data.frame(mg_subclds_NMS$points[, c(1, 2)]) |>
  merge(rt_curto_rar@sam_data, by = "row.names", all.x = TRUE) |>
  # Ordered inoculum factor
  mutate(i_code = factor(i_code,
                         levels = c(sort(unique(i_code))[c(1:7, 9, 10, 8)]))) |>
  # Pair labels
  add_pair_label() |>
  mutate(
    S_home_open = case_when(
      Bag_type == "Open"  & s_home == "home" ~ "Open_home",
      Bag_type == "Open"  & s_home == "away" ~ "Open_away",
      TRUE                                   ~ s_home
    )
  )
```

### All reserves — colored by inoculum

```{r nmds-all-reserves, fig.width=22, fig.height=12}
subclades_nmds_df |>
  filter(Site != "L00") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = i_code, shape = S_home_open)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ reserve_code, scales = "fixed", ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = inoc_colors, name = "Inoculum") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(home = 16, away = 17, Open_home = 1, Open_away = 2),
                     breaks = c("home", "away", "Open_home", "Open_away"),
                     name   = "Substrate") +
  ggtitle("Curtobacterium subclades — all reserves") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "right")

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "all_reservs_nmds.png"),
       width = 216, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
```

### Loma Ridge only

```{r nmds-loma, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
subclades_nmds_df |>
  filter(Bag_type != "Open", reserve_code == "LOMA") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = i_code, shape = s_code)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = inoc_colors,                              name = "Inoculum") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15:18, 0:2, 5, 12, 13, 21, 22, 3, 4), name = "Litter") +
  ggtitle("Curtobacterium subclades — Loma Ridge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "right")

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "LOMA_nmds.png"),
       width = 120, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### LOMA inoculum — all pairs

```{r nmds-loma-inoc, fig.width=22, fig.height=12}
# Expand LOMA-vs-LOMA rows into each away-vs-LOMA pair context
expanded_df <- expand_loma_rows(
  subclades_nmds_df |> add_pair_label(),
  others
) |>
  filter(!pair %in% c("LOMA vs LOMA", "none vs LOMA"),
         i_code != "none") |>
  mutate(
    s_loma_away = factor(if_else(s_code == "LOMA", "LOMA", "away"), levels = c("LOMA", "away")),
    r_loma_away = factor(if_else(reserve_code == "LOMA", "LOMA", "away"), levels = c("LOMA", "away")),
    i_loma_away = factor(if_else(i_code == "LOMA", "LOMA", "away"), levels = c("LOMA", "away"))
  )

expanded_df |>
  filter(i_code == "LOMA", pair != "LOMA vs LOMA") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = reserve_code, shape = s_code)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 1) +
  facet_wrap(pair ~., scales = "fixed", ncol = 4,
             labeller = labeller(pair = \(x) sub(" vs LOMA", "", x))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = reserve_colors, name = "Reserve") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15:18, 0:2, 5, 12, 13, 21, 22, 3, 4), name = "Litter") +
  ggtitle("Samples with LOMA inoculum, by pair") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "right")

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "i_LOMA_nmds_facet_by_pair.png"),
       width = 216, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### LOMA inoculum — centroids by reserve × litter (subclades)

```{r nmds-subcl-cent-ReserveByLitter, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
subclade_cent_rl <- subclades_nmds_df |>
  filter(i_code == "LOMA") |>
  group_by(reserve_code, s_code) |>
  summarise(
    meanMDS1 = mean(MDS1), meanMDS2 = mean(MDS2),
    seMDS1   = sd(MDS1) / sqrt(n()),
    seMDS2   = sd(MDS2) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

subclades_cent_plot_i_LOMA <- ggplot(subclade_cent_rl,
       aes(x = meanMDS1, y = meanMDS2, color = reserve_code, shape = s_code)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke = 0.75, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanMDS2 - seMDS2, ymax = meanMDS2 + seMDS2),
                width = 0.02, alpha = 0.5) +

                 height = 0.02, alpha = 0.5) +

  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15:18, 0:2, 5, 12, 13, 21, 22, 3, 4), name = "Litter") +

           x     = 0.02,
           y     = 0.25,
           label = "Site *** (20.2%)\nLitter *** (15.8%)\nSite x Litter *** (27.8%)",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 0.4)),
    legend.key.size    = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x   = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y   = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.margin      = margin(t = 0.25, r = 0.2, b = 0.1, l = 0.2),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(b = 1.25, l = 1.5, unit = "pt")),
    text               = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position    = "right"
  )

print(subclades_cent_plot_i_LOMA)
```

### Away inocula across reserves

```{r nmds-away-inoc, fig.width=22, fig.height=10}
pval_text_subcl <- anova_tables_inoc |>
  filter(term == "reserve_code", p.value < 0.05) |>
  transmute(i_code, label = paste0("p = ", signif(p.value, 2)))

subclades_nmds_df |>
  filter(Bag_type != "Open", i_code != "LOMA", s_code != "LOMA") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = reserve_code)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ i_code, scales = "fixed", ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = inoc_colors, name = "Reserve") +
  ggtitle("Away inocula across reserves") +
  geom_text(data = pval_text_subcl, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "right")

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "I_away_across_reservs_nmds.png"),
       width = 216, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
```

### Per-pair NMDS panels (small multiples)

```{r nmds-per-pair, fig.width=22, fig.height=12}
pairs_for_loop <- sort(unique(subclades_nmds_df$pair))
pairs_for_loop <- pairs_for_loop[!pairs_for_loop %in% c("LOMA vs LOMA", "none vs LOMA")]

plot_list <- map(pairs_for_loop, function(target_pair) {
  subset_res  <- str_split(target_pair, " ")[[1]][1]
  res_levels  <- c(subset_res, "LOMA")
  shape_vals  <- setNames(c(21, 24), res_levels)

  subclades_nmds_df |>
    filter(i_code != "none",
           pair %in% c(target_pair, "LOMA vs LOMA")) |>
    mutate(fill_home = if_else(s_code == i_code, s_code, NA_character_)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2,
               shape = reserve_code, color = i_code, fill = fill_home)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = inoc_colors, breaks = res_levels, name = "Inoculum",
                        guide = guide_legend(order = 2, title.position = "top",
                                             direction = "horizontal")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, breaks = res_levels, name = "Reserve",
                       guide = guide_legend(order = 1, title.position = "top",
                                            direction = "horizontal")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = reserve_colors, na.value = NA,
                      breaks = c(subset_res, NA), labels = c("home", "away"),
                      name = "Litter = home",
                      guide = guide_legend(order = 3, title.position = "top",
                                           direction = "horizontal",
                                           override.aes = list(shape = c(15, 0),
                                                               colour = "black",
                                                               size = 1.5, stroke = 0.5))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.4, 0.4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.4, 0.4)) +
    labs(title = target_pair) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", text = element_text(size = 4),
          legend.title    = element_text(size = 5),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 4))
})
names(plot_list) <- pairs_for_loop

all_reserves_plot <- ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 4, nrow = 2)
print(all_reserves_plot)

ggsave(all_reserves_plot,
       file = file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "awayVSloma_nmds.png"),
       width = 216, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
```

### NMDS centroids with error bars

```{r nmds-centroids, fig.width=22, fig.height=12}
expanded_df <- expanded_df |>
  mutate(treatment3 = paste(treatment_2, pair, sep = "|"))

expanded_df_centroids <- expanded_df |>
  group_by(treatment3) |>
  summarise(meanMDS1 = mean(MDS1), meanMDS2 = mean(MDS2),
            sdMDS1   = sd(MDS1),   sdMDS2   = sd(MDS2),
            seMDS1   = sd(MDS1) / sqrt(n()),
            seMDS2   = sd(MDS2) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups  = "drop") |>
  left_join(expanded_df, by = "treatment3") |>
  distinct(treatment3, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  add_irl_label()

cent <- expanded_df_centroids |>
  select(pair, i_code, reserve_litter, i_r_l, Bag_type,
         meanMDS1, meanMDS2, seMDS1, seMDS2)

nmds_curto_pairs <- cent |>
  filter(!(i_code == "none" & Bag_type == "Closed")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = meanMDS1, y = meanMDS2, shape = i_r_l, color = i_code)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanMDS2 - seMDS2, ymax = meanMDS2 + seMDS2),
                width = 0.025, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = meanMDS1 - seMDS1, xmax = meanMDS1 + seMDS1),
                 height = 0.025, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = inoc_colors, name = "Inoculum") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(`LOMA|LOMA & LOMA`     = 16,
               `away|away & non-LOMA` = 16,
               `LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 15,
               `away|away & LOMA`     = 15,
               `LOMA|away & LOMA`     = 17,
               `away|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 17,
               `LOMA|away & non-LOMA` = 18),
    name   = "Treatment",
    breaks = c("LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
               "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA", "LOMA|away & LOMA",
               "LOMA|away & non-LOMA"),
    labels = c("Native",
               "\u0394 Litter", "\u0394 Climate", "\u0394 Climate & Litter"),
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2") +
  facet_wrap(pair ~., scales = "fixed", ncol = 4,
             labeller = labeller(pair = \(x) sub(" vs LOMA", "", x))) +
  theme_minimal()

print(nmds_curto_pairs)

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "Reserves_awayvsLOMA_inoc_color_nmds_CENTROIDS.png"),
       width = 180, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r nmds-curto-pairs-loma-away-native}
# LOMA inoculum treatments + away community on its own litter & climate only
# Color groups:
#   LOMA        = LOMA inoculum in full LOMA conditions (green)
#   Intermediate = LOMA inoculum but away litter and/or climate (gray)
#   Away        = away community on own litter & climate (purple)
nmds_curto_pairs_focal <- cent |>
  filter(
    i_code == "LOMA" |
    (i_code %in% others & reserve_litter == "away & non-LOMA")
  ) |>
  mutate(color_group = case_when(
    i_code == "LOMA" & reserve_litter == "LOMA & LOMA" ~ "LOMA",
    i_code == "LOMA"                                   ~ "Intermediate",
    TRUE                                               ~ "Away"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = meanMDS1, y = meanMDS2, shape = i_r_l, color = color_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanMDS2 - seMDS2, ymax = meanMDS2 + seMDS2),
                width = 0.025, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = meanMDS1 - seMDS1, xmax = meanMDS1 + seMDS1),
                 height = 0.025, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(LOMA = "#548B54", Intermediate = "gray60", Away = "#7B4F9E"),
    breaks = c("LOMA", "Intermediate", "Away"),
    name   = "Community"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(`LOMA|LOMA & LOMA`     = 16,
               `away|away & non-LOMA` = 16,
               `LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 15,
               `away|away & LOMA`     = 15,
               `LOMA|away & LOMA`     = 17,
               `away|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 17,
               `LOMA|away & non-LOMA` = 18),
    name   = "Treatment",
    breaks = c("LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
               "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA", "LOMA|away & LOMA",
               "LOMA|away & non-LOMA"),
    labels = c("native environment",
               "litter only", "climate only", "climate & litter"),
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2") +
  facet_wrap(pair ~., scales = "fixed", ncol = 4,
             labeller = labeller(pair = \(x) sub(" vs LOMA", "", x))) +
  theme_minimal()

print(nmds_curto_pairs_focal)

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "Reserves_LOMA_inoc_and_away_native_nmds_CENTROIDS.png"),
       width = 180, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r nmds-curto-pairs-away-inoc-intermediate}
# LOMA community (own litter & climate) + away inoculum treatments
# Color groups:
#   LOMA         = LOMA inoculum in full LOMA conditions (green)
#   Intermediate = away inoculum on non-native litter and/or climate (gray)
#   Away         = away community on own litter & climate (purple)
nmds_curto_pairs_focal_away <- cent |>
  filter(
    (i_code == "LOMA" & reserve_litter == "LOMA & LOMA") |

  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(LOMA = "#548B54", Intermediate = "gray60", Away = "#7B4F9E"),
    breaks = c("LOMA", "Intermediate", "Away"),
    name   = "Community"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(`LOMA|LOMA & LOMA`     = 16,
               `away|away & non-LOMA` = 16,
               `LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 15,
               `away|away & LOMA`     = 15,
               `LOMA|away & LOMA`     = 17,
               `away|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 17,
               `LOMA|away & non-LOMA` = 18),
    name   = "Treatment",
    breaks = c("away|away & non-LOMA",
               "away|away & LOMA", "away|LOMA & non-LOMA"),
    labels = c("native environment",
               "litter only", "climate only"),
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2") +
  facet_wrap(pair ~., scales = "fixed", ncol = 4,
             labeller = labeller(pair = \(x) sub(" vs LOMA", "", x))) +
  theme_minimal()

print(nmds_curto_pairs_focal_away)

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "Reserves_away_inoc_intermediate_nmds_CENTROIDS.png"),
       width = 180, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Bacterial genus NMDS

```{r nmds-genus}
set.seed(SEED)
mg_genus_NMS <- metaMDS(mg_genus_distmat, k = 3, maxit = 999,
                        trymax = 500, wascores = TRUE)
cat("Genus NMDS stress:", mg_genus_NMS$stress, "\n")
stressplot(mg_genus_NMS)
```

```{r nmds-genus-df}
genus_nmds_df <- as.data.frame(mg_genus_NMS$points[, c(1, 2)]) |>
  merge(rt_g_rar@sam_data, by = "row.names", all.x = TRUE) |>
  mutate(i_code = factor(i_code,
                         levels = c(sort(unique(i_code))[c(1:7, 9, 10, 8)]))) |>
  add_pair_label() |>
  mutate(
    S_home_open = case_when(
      Bag_type == "Open"  & s_home == "home" ~ "Open_home",
      Bag_type == "Open"  & s_home == "away" ~ "Open_away",
      TRUE                                   ~ s_home
    )
  )
```

```{r nmds-genus-per-pair, fig.width=22, fig.height=12}
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals, breaks = res_levels, name = "Reserve",
```

## Euclidean distance PCA

### Compute averaged Euclidean distances

```{r euc-distances}
# Load non-rarefied objects (following 04_convergence.Rmd approach)
rt_subclades <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_subclades.rds"))
rt_g         <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_g.rds"))

# Subclade Euclidean: top 4 subclades
rt_TopSubclades   <- subset_taxa(rt_subclades, subclade %in% c("IC", "IIG", "IIIA", "IVB"))
curto_Top4_otutab <- as.data.frame(t(rt_TopSubclades@otu_table))
cat("Min library size (top 4 subclades):", min(sample_sums(rt_TopSubclades)), "\n")

avg_euc <- calc_rarefaction_euclidean(
  otu_table      = curto_Top4_otutab,
  n_iterations   = N_ITER,
  sequence_depth = RAREFY_DEPTH_TOP4,
  set_seed       = SEED
)

# Genus Euclidean: top 400 genera
top400_genera <- names(sort(taxa_sums(rt_g), decreasing = TRUE)[1:400])
rt_g_top400   <- prune_taxa(top400_genera, rt_g)
cat("Min library size (top 400 genera):", min(sample_sums(rt_g_top400)), "\n")

genus_avg_euc <- calc_rarefaction_euclidean(
  otu_table      = as.data.frame(t(rt_g_top400@otu_table)),
  n_iterations   = N_ITER,
  sequence_depth = min(sample_sums(rt_g_top400)),
  set_seed       = SEED
)
```

### Run NMDS

```{r euc-pca}
pca_subcl  <- cmdscale(avg_euc,       k = 2, eig = TRUE)
pca_genus  <- cmdscale(genus_avg_euc, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

var_subcl  <- round(pca_subcl$eig[1:2]  / sum(pca_subcl$eig[pca_subcl$eig   > 0]) * 100, 1)
var_genus  <- round(pca_genus$eig[1:2]  / sum(pca_genus$eig[pca_genus$eig   > 0]) * 100, 1)

# Axis label formatter for genus-level Euclidean plots (large units → K)
k_labels <- \(x) ifelse(x == 0, "0", paste0(x / 1000, "K"))

cat("Subclade PC1:", var_subcl[1], "%  PC2:", var_subcl[2], "%\n")
cat("Genus   PC1:", var_genus[1],  "%  PC2:", var_genus[2],  "%\n")
```

### Curtobacterium subclades — PCA centroids

```{r pca-subcl-df}
pca_subcl_df <- as.data.frame(pca_subcl$points) |>
  setNames(c("PC1", "PC2")) |>
  merge(rt_TopSubclades@sam_data, by = "row.names", all.x = TRUE) |>
  mutate(i_code = factor(i_code,
                         levels = c(sort(unique(i_code))[c(1:7, 9, 10, 8)]))) |>
  add_pair_label()

pca_expanded_df <- expand_loma_rows(pca_subcl_df, others) |>
  filter(!pair %in% c("LOMA vs LOMA", "none vs LOMA"),
         i_code != "none") |>
  add_irl_label() |>
  mutate(
    s_loma_away = factor(if_else(s_code == "LOMA", "LOMA", "away"), levels = c("LOMA", "away")),
    r_loma_away = factor(if_else(reserve_code == "LOMA", "LOMA", "away"), levels = c("LOMA", "away")),
    i_loma_away = factor(if_else(i_code == "LOMA", "LOMA", "away"), levels = c("LOMA", "away"))
  ) |>
  mutate(treatment3 = paste(treatment_2, pair, sep = "|"))

pca_subcl_centroids <- pca_expanded_df |>
  group_by(treatment3) |>
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1), meanPC2 = mean(PC2),
            sePC1   = sd(PC1) / sqrt(n()),
            sePC2   = sd(PC2) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(pca_expanded_df, by = "treatment3") |>
  distinct(treatment3, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  add_irl_label()

cent_pca <- pca_subcl_centroids |>
  select(pair, i_code, reserve_litter, i_r_l, Bag_type,
         meanPC1, meanPC2, sePC1, sePC2)
```

```{r pca-subcl-focal-loma}
pca_subcl_focal <- cent_pca |>
  filter(
    i_code == "LOMA" |
    (i_code %in% others & reserve_litter == "away & non-LOMA")
  ) |>
  mutate(color_group = case_when(
    i_code == "LOMA" & reserve_litter == "LOMA & LOMA" ~ "LOMA",
    i_code == "LOMA"                                   ~ "Intermediate",
    TRUE                                               ~ "Away"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = meanPC1, y = meanPC2, shape = i_r_l, color = color_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanPC2 - sePC2, ymax = meanPC2 + sePC2),
                width = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = meanPC1 - sePC1, xmax = meanPC1 + sePC1),
                 height = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(LOMA = "#548B54", Intermediate = "gray60", Away = "#7B4F9E"),
    breaks = c("LOMA", "Intermediate", "Away"),
    name   = "Community"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(`LOMA|LOMA & LOMA`     = 16,
               `away|away & non-LOMA` = 16,
               `LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 15,
               `away|away & LOMA`     = 15,
               `LOMA|away & LOMA`     = 17,
               `away|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 17,
               `LOMA|away & non-LOMA` = 18),
    name   = "Treatment",
    breaks = c("LOMA|LOMA & LOMA",
               "LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA", "LOMA|away & LOMA",
               "LOMA|away & non-LOMA"),
    labels = c("Native", "\u0394 Litter", "\u0394 Climate", "\u0394 Climate & Litter"),
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_subcl[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_subcl[2], "%)")) +
  facet_wrap(pair ~., scales = "fixed", ncol = 4,
             labeller = labeller(pair = \(x) sub(" vs LOMA", "", x))) +
  theme_minimal()

print(pca_subcl_focal)

       width = 180, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Euclidean distance NMDS

### Run NMDS

```{r euc-nmds}
set.seed(SEED)
euc_nmds_subcl <- metaMDS(avg_euc, k = 3, maxit = 999, trymax = 500, wascores = TRUE)
cat("Subclade Euclidean NMDS stress:", euc_nmds_subcl$stress, "\n")

set.seed(SEED)
euc_nmds_genus <- metaMDS(genus_avg_euc, k = 3, maxit = 999, trymax = 500, wascores = TRUE)
cat("Genus Euclidean NMDS stress:", euc_nmds_genus$stress, "\n")
```


## Euclidean PCA and NMDS — with controls

Controls are open bags (passive colonisation, no inoculum added) and closed bags with no
inoculum (`i_code == "none"`). Both are shown as semi-transparent centroids alongside the
inoculated treatments, coloured orange (no inoculum) and blue (open bag).

```{r ctrl-helpers}
# Expand LOMA-site controls (pair == "none vs LOMA") into every away-vs-LOMA facet
expand_ctrl_rows <- function(ctrl_df, others) {
  loma_rows <- ctrl_df |> filter(pair == "none vs LOMA")
  away_rows <- ctrl_df |> filter(pair != "none vs LOMA", pair != "LOMA vs LOMA")
  bind_rows(
    loma_rows |> select(-pair) |> crossing(pair = paste(others, "vs LOMA")),
    away_rows
  )
}

# Compute control centroids from any ordination data frame
build_ctrl_centroids <- function(df, coord1, coord2) {
  df |>
    filter(i_code == "none" | Bag_type == "Open") |>
    add_irl_label() |>
    mutate(
      ctrl_type = if_else(Bag_type == "Open", "Open bag", "No inoculum"),
      i_r_l     = if_else(Bag_type == "Open",
                          paste("open", reserve_litter, sep = "|"),
                          paste("ctrl", reserve_litter, sep = "|"))
    ) |>
    expand_ctrl_rows(others) |>
    group_by(pair, ctrl_type, reserve_litter, i_r_l) |>
    summarise(
      meanC1 = mean(.data[[coord1]]), meanC2 = mean(.data[[coord2]]),
      seC1   = sd(.data[[coord1]])  / sqrt(n()),
      seC2   = sd(.data[[coord2]])  / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    rename(!!paste0("mean", coord1) := meanC1,
           !!paste0("mean", coord2) := meanC2,
           !!paste0("se",   coord1) := seC1,
           !!paste0("se",   coord2) := seC2)
}

color_vals_ctrl <- c(
  LOMA          = "#548B54",
  Intermediate  = "gray60",
  Away          = "#7B4F9E",
  `No inoculum` = "#E69F00",
  `Open bag`    = "#56B4E9"
)

shape_vals <- c(
  `LOMA|LOMA & LOMA`     = 16, `away|away & non-LOMA` = 16,
  `LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 15, `away|away & LOMA`     = 15,
  `LOMA|away & LOMA`     = 17, `away|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 17,
  `LOMA|away & non-LOMA` = 18
)

shape_vals_ctrl <- c(
  shape_vals,
  `ctrl|LOMA & LOMA`     = 16, `ctrl|away & non-LOMA` = 16,
  `ctrl|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 15, `ctrl|away & LOMA`     = 17,
  `open|LOMA & LOMA`     = 16, `open|away & non-LOMA` = 16,
  `open|LOMA & non-LOMA` = 15, `open|away & LOMA`     = 17
)

make_ctrl_focal <- function(exp_cent, ctrl_cent,
                            inoculum   = "LOMA",
                            coord1     = "PC1", coord2 = "PC2",
                            xlab       = "PC1", ylab   = "PC2",
                            point_size = 2.5) {
  if (inoculum == "LOMA") {
    exp_df <- exp_cent |>
      filter(i_code == "LOMA" | (i_code %in% others & reserve_litter == "away & non-LOMA")) |>
      mutate(community_label = case_when(
        i_code == "LOMA" & reserve_litter == "LOMA & LOMA" ~ "LOMA",
        i_code == "LOMA"                                   ~ "Intermediate",
        TRUE                                               ~ "Away"))
    s_breaks <- c("LOMA|LOMA & LOMA","LOMA|LOMA & non-LOMA","LOMA|away & LOMA","LOMA|away & non-LOMA")
    s_labels <- c("native environment","litter only","climate only","both")
  } else {
    exp_df <- exp_cent |>
      filter((i_code == "LOMA" & reserve_litter == "LOMA & LOMA") | i_code %in% others) |>
      mutate(community_label = case_when(
        i_code == "LOMA"                                          ~ "LOMA",
        i_code %in% others & reserve_litter == "away & non-LOMA" ~ "Away",
        TRUE                                                      ~ "Intermediate"))
    s_breaks <- c("away|away & non-LOMA","away|away & LOMA","away|LOMA & non-LOMA")
    s_labels <- c("native environment","litter only","climate only")
  }
  combined <- bind_rows(
    exp_df    |> mutate(is_ctrl = FALSE, community_label = community_label),
    ctrl_cent |> mutate(is_ctrl = TRUE,  community_label = ctrl_type)
  )
  ggplot(combined,
         aes(x     = .data[[paste0("mean", coord1)]],
             y     = .data[[paste0("mean", coord2)]],
             shape = i_r_l,
             color = community_label,
             alpha = is_ctrl)) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, stroke = 0.75) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = .data[[paste0("mean", coord2)]] - .data[[paste0("se", coord2)]],
          ymax = .data[[paste0("mean", coord2)]] + .data[[paste0("se", coord2)]]),
      width = if (coord1 == "PC1") 0.5 else 0.025, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = .data[[paste0("mean", coord1)]] - .data[[paste0("se", coord1)]],
          xmax = .data[[paste0("mean", coord1)]] + .data[[paste0("se", coord1)]]),
      height = if (coord1 == "PC1") 0.5 else 0.025, alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = color_vals_ctrl,
                        breaks = names(color_vals_ctrl), name = "Community") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_vals_ctrl, name = "Treatment",
                       breaks = s_breaks, labels = s_labels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.85, `TRUE` = 0.5), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    facet_wrap(pair ~., scales = "fixed", ncol = 4,
               labeller = labeller(pair = \(x) sub(" vs LOMA", "", x))) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

## Harmonise axis limits across focal plot pairs

Plots within each ordination × taxonomic-level group share the same axis limits so that
the LOMA-focal and away-focal panels are directly comparable.

```{r harmonise-axis-limits}
get_limits <- function(cent_list, x, y, sx, sy, pad = 0.07) {
  d  <- bind_rows(cent_list)
  xr <- range(c(d[[x]] - d[[sx]], d[[x]] + d[[sx]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  yr <- range(c(d[[y]] - d[[sy]], d[[y]] + d[[sy]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  xp <- diff(xr) * pad;  yp <- diff(yr) * pad
  list(xlim = xr + c(-xp, xp), ylim = yr + c(-yp, yp))
}
apply_limits <- function(p, lims)
  p + coord_cartesian(xlim = lims$xlim, ylim = lims$ylim)

lims_subcl_bc  <- get_limits(list(cent),                                    "meanMDS1","meanMDS2","seMDS1","seMDS2")
lims_subcl_enm <- get_limits(list(cent_euc_nmds, euc_nmds_subcl_ctrl),      "meanMDS1","meanMDS2","seMDS1","seMDS2")
lims_subcl_pca <- get_limits(list(cent_pca,      pca_subcl_ctrl),           "meanPC1", "meanPC2", "sePC1", "sePC2")
lims_genus_bc  <- get_limits(list(cent_genus),                              "meanMDS1","meanMDS2","seMDS1","seMDS2")
lims_genus_enm <- get_limits(list(cent_genus_euc_nmds, euc_nmds_genus_ctrl),"meanMDS1","meanMDS2","seMDS1","seMDS2")
lims_genus_pca <- get_limits(list(cent_genus_pca,      pca_genus_ctrl),     "meanPC1", "meanPC2", "sePC1", "sePC2")

# Subclade BC NMDS
nmds_curto_pairs_focal      <- apply_limits(nmds_curto_pairs_focal,      lims_subcl_bc)
nmds_curto_pairs_focal_away <- apply_limits(nmds_curto_pairs_focal_away, lims_subcl_bc)

# Subclade Euclidean NMDS
nmds_euc_subcl_focal             <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_subcl_focal,             lims_subcl_enm)
nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away        <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away,        lims_subcl_enm)
nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal        <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal,        lims_subcl_enm)
nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal_away   <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal_away,   lims_subcl_enm)

# Subclade PCA
pca_subcl_focal             <- apply_limits(pca_subcl_focal,             lims_subcl_pca)
pca_subcl_focal_away        <- apply_limits(pca_subcl_focal_away,        lims_subcl_pca)
pca_subcl_ctrl_focal        <- apply_limits(pca_subcl_ctrl_focal,        lims_subcl_pca)
pca_subcl_ctrl_focal_away   <- apply_limits(pca_subcl_ctrl_focal_away,   lims_subcl_pca)

# Genus BC NMDS
nmds_genus_focal      <- apply_limits(nmds_genus_focal,      lims_genus_bc)
nmds_genus_focal_away <- apply_limits(nmds_genus_focal_away, lims_genus_bc)

# Genus Euclidean NMDS
nmds_euc_genus_focal             <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_genus_focal,             lims_genus_enm)
nmds_euc_genus_focal_away        <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_genus_focal_away,        lims_genus_enm)
nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal        <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal,        lims_genus_enm)
nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal_away   <- apply_limits(nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal_away,   lims_genus_enm)

# Genus PCA
pca_genus_focal             <- apply_limits(pca_genus_focal,             lims_genus_pca)
pca_genus_focal_away        <- apply_limits(pca_genus_focal_away,        lims_genus_pca)
pca_genus_ctrl_focal        <- apply_limits(pca_genus_ctrl_focal,        lims_genus_pca)
pca_genus_ctrl_focal_away   <- apply_limits(pca_genus_ctrl_focal_away,   lims_genus_pca)

# Standardise legend, axis, and strip text sizes across all focal plots
focal_theme <- theme(
  text            = element_text(size = 8),
  axis.title      = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text       = element_text(size = 7),
  strip.text      = element_text(size = 8),
  legend.title    = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
  legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
  legend.key.size = unit(3.5, "mm")
)

all_focal <- list(
  nmds_curto_pairs_focal, nmds_curto_pairs_focal_away,
  nmds_euc_subcl_focal, nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away,
  nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal, nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal_away,
  pca_subcl_focal, pca_subcl_focal_away,
  pca_subcl_ctrl_focal, pca_subcl_ctrl_focal_away,
  nmds_genus_focal, nmds_genus_focal_away,
  nmds_euc_genus_focal, nmds_euc_genus_focal_away,
  nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal, nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal_away,
  pca_genus_focal, pca_genus_focal_away,
  pca_genus_ctrl_focal, pca_genus_ctrl_focal_away
)
all_focal <- lapply(all_focal, \(p) p + focal_theme)
list2env(setNames(all_focal, c(
  "nmds_curto_pairs_focal", "nmds_curto_pairs_focal_away",
  "nmds_euc_subcl_focal", "nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away",
  "nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal", "nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal_away",
  "pca_subcl_focal", "pca_subcl_focal_away",
  "pca_subcl_ctrl_focal", "pca_subcl_ctrl_focal_away",
  "nmds_genus_focal", "nmds_genus_focal_away",
  "nmds_euc_genus_focal", "nmds_euc_genus_focal_away",
  "nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal", "nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal_away",
  "pca_genus_focal", "pca_genus_focal_away",
  "pca_genus_ctrl_focal", "pca_genus_ctrl_focal_away"
)), envir = .GlobalEnv)
```

```{r nmds-cent-RL-combined, fig.width=18, fig.height=8}
p_cent_RL_combined <- ggarrange(
  pca_genus_focal, pca_subcl_focal,
  ncol          = 1,
  labels        = c("A", "B"),
  common.legend = TRUE,

p_cent_RL_combined
```

## Combined: genus (top) × subclade (bottom) stacked figures

Each figure pairs the genus-level and subclade-level ordination of the same type and
focal view, stacked vertically with a shared legend.

```{r combined-stacked, message=FALSE}
library(cowplot)

# Legend on top panel only; bottom panel legend suppressed.
# cowplot align = "v" / axis = "lr" keeps facet columns flush.
stack_plots <- function(top, bottom) {
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    top    + theme(legend.position = "right"),
    bottom + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    ncol       = 1,
    labels     = c("A", "B"),
    label_size = 9,
    align      = "v",
    axis       = "lr"
  )
}

combined_bc_nmds_loma         <- stack_plots(nmds_genus_focal,               nmds_curto_pairs_focal)
combined_bc_nmds_away         <- stack_plots(nmds_genus_focal_away,           nmds_curto_pairs_focal_away)
combined_pca_loma             <- stack_plots(pca_genus_focal,                 pca_subcl_focal)
combined_pca_away             <- stack_plots(pca_genus_focal_away,            pca_subcl_focal_away)
combined_euc_nmds_loma        <- stack_plots(nmds_euc_genus_focal,            nmds_euc_subcl_focal)
combined_euc_nmds_away        <- stack_plots(nmds_euc_genus_focal_away,       nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away)
combined_pca_ctrl_loma        <- stack_plots(pca_genus_ctrl_focal,            pca_subcl_ctrl_focal)
combined_pca_ctrl_away        <- stack_plots(pca_genus_ctrl_focal_away,       pca_subcl_ctrl_focal_away)
combined_euc_nmds_ctrl_loma   <- stack_plots(nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal,       nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal)
combined_euc_nmds_ctrl_away   <- stack_plots(nmds_euc_genus_ctrl_focal_away,  nmds_euc_subcl_ctrl_focal_away)

combined_list <- list(
  list(combined_bc_nmds_loma,       "combined_BC_NMDS_LOMA_focal.png",        200, 200),
  list(combined_bc_nmds_away,       "combined_BC_NMDS_away_focal.png",        200, 200),
  list(combined_pca_loma,           "combined_PCA_EUC_LOMA_focal.png",        200, 200),
  list(combined_pca_away,           "combined_PCA_EUC_away_focal.png",        200, 200),
  list(combined_euc_nmds_loma,      "combined_EUC_NMDS_LOMA_focal.png",       200, 200),
  list(combined_euc_nmds_away,      "combined_EUC_NMDS_away_focal.png",       200, 200),
  list(combined_pca_ctrl_loma,      "combined_PCA_EUC_ctrl_LOMA_focal.png",   220, 220),
  list(combined_pca_ctrl_away,      "combined_PCA_EUC_ctrl_away_focal.png",   220, 220),
  list(combined_euc_nmds_ctrl_loma, "combined_EUC_NMDS_ctrl_LOMA_focal.png",  220, 220),
  list(combined_euc_nmds_ctrl_away, "combined_EUC_NMDS_ctrl_away_focal.png",  220, 220)
)


for (item in combined_list) {
  print(item[[1]])
}


for (item in combined_list) {
  ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", item[[2]]),
         item[[1]], width = item[[3]], height = item[[4]],
         units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```
